Thanks again for the time yesterday — this thread is to lock in a concise mutual action plan (MAP) for the marketplace private offer (AWS + GCP path) so procurement and finance have clear checkpoints between evaluation, technical acceptance, and final invoice routing. - Milestone 3 (Marketplace private offer activation): Once legal sign-off and finance PO received, we’ll accept the private offer through either AWS Private Offers (preferred for existing AWS spend) or GCP Private Offer flow depending on final cloud selection.
- Billing path: Preferred flow is marketplace invoice -> Solara pays marketplace invoice -> Redwood receives payout. If Solara requires direct invoicing we will coordinate a reseller route and draft invoice ladder. Finance contact on your side (samir?) please confirm.
- Cutover/GA: Target production switch 6/27 (can be earlier if acceptance completes).

Please confirm owners for the TAC, legal, and finance checkpoints. I’ve attached a redlines slot (Solara_Redlines_v2.pdf) for your legal team to populate.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP file as we confirm dates.

—Markus
